name: Upflix
subtitle: Streaming Guide
description: Upflix is a streaming guide that helps millions of users discover what's new and where to watch it. Built with Titanium and running for more than a decade, Upflix tracks movies and TV shows across major streaming services, with daily updates, personalized notifications, watchlists, ratings, release rankings, and smart discovery features. It helps users keep up with an ever-changing streaming landscape without having to search each streaming service individually.
